description: Build a correct tel: click-to-call link from any phone number, with optional extension — perfect for mobile-friendly contact pages.

faqs.a: tel: links tell mobile devices to open the phone dialer with the number pre-filled. On desktops they open the default calling app (e.g. Skype, FaceTime).
The number is normalized to E.164-style digits with a leading +, so it dials correctly from any country.
faqs.q: Do I need to format the number myself?

faqs.a: Enter it in the extension field and the tool appends ;ext=123, which dialers understand.
Yes — everything is done locally in your browser.

howto: Type the phone number in any format, plus an optional extension.
The normalized tel: link appears instantly.
Tap the link to test it, or copy it for your website.
title: Tel Link Generator
